children: Fold Holdings moved to end its $250 million Equity Purchase Facility Agreement with the Investor, delivering notice on Aug 27, 2026 and setting an effective termination date of Sep 3, 2026. No advance notices were outstanding, and no fees or penalties apply. In connection with the facility’s termination, the company’s obligations under the related Registration Rights Agreement will also terminate, except for any obligations that survive if the Investor still holds registrable securities. The actions are intended to provide greater flexibility to pursue alternative financing options.
